column1:
• Expansion of green and transition finance offerings
can drive loan book growth.
• Asset quality improvement - strengthens loan book
quality and reduces non-performing loans (NPLs)
from high-risk, carbon-intensive sectors.
• Demand for sustainable investment products can
generate new fee-based income and advisory
revenue.
• Diversification into climate finance mechanisms
can open new income streams from carbon
markets, impact investments, and blended finance
partnerships
• Risk mitigation and improved credit quality.
column3:
• Expansion to infrastructure upgrades, flood-resistant
buildings, water security, and agricultural adaptation
can drive loan book expansion.
• Providing parametric insurance and climate risk
coverage creates new fee-based income from risk-
mitigation products.
• Demand for sustainability advisory services can
generate non-interest income as businesses seek
guidance on climate adaptation strategies.
• Financing climate-resilient projects helps mitigate
default risks in sectors exposed to extreme weather
events (e.g., agriculture, real estate, and infrastructure).
• Supporting businesses in climate adaptation
strengthens their financial stability, reducing loan
impairments and non-performing loans (NPLs).
• Climate risk assessments improve loan underwriting
processes, ensuring better credit risk management.
• Potential Short-Term Costs: Initial investments in
climate risk assessments, capacity-building, and
technology integration may temporarily increase
operating expenses.
